synthetic_chat_specificity.description: Scaled latent-decoupling reproduction of the paper's Gemma 2 2B crosscoder comparison. Paper-reported anchors: Table 1 false FT-only rates and Table 4 FT-only counts; remaining alignment fields are benchmark analogues used to score the scaled synthetic setting.

fraction_top_norm_scaling_specific.description: Rewards top chat-norm latents whose reconstruction and residual scaling indicate genuine chat-specific structure.

fraction_top_norm_true_chat.description: Rewards top chat-norm latents aligned to held-out true chat-only concept directions.

fraction_top_norm_weak_or_shared.description: Penalizes top chat-norm latents aligned to weak shared or fully shared concept directions.

chat_only_latent_count.description: Penalizes excessive decoder-norm chat-only labels so methods cannot win by over-marking latents as chat-specific.

false_ft_only_rate_pi06.description: Penalizes high-norm chat-only labels whose scaling statistics fail the pi=0.6 specificity check.

reconstruction_fve.description: Rewards aggregate fraction of variance explained across both paired activation streams.

base_reconstruction_fve.description: Rewards reconstruction quality on the base activation stream to catch one-sided reconstruction shortcuts.

chat_reconstruction_fve.description: Rewards reconstruction quality on the chat activation stream to catch one-sided reconstruction shortcuts.

mean_l0.description: Penalizes denser latent activations so specificity gains cannot come only from using many more active features.

synthetic_complete_shrinkage.description: Scaled complete-shrinkage reproduction of the same paper claim: weak concepts present in both streams can be misidentified as fine-tuned-only by L1 norm differences, while BatchTopK should reduce that artifact.
